exercises.problemHtml:
Lab 6 — CT Shop: a checkout that can never half-happen

PostgreSQL course · after Chapter 12 · Suggested time: 100 minutes · 10 marks (5 × 2)

1. Overview

CT Shop moves checkout into the database: a view that audits the stock ledger, a trigger that writes the ledger whenever stock changes, a function that turns a JSON cart into lines, the checkout function itself, and a guard on payments. Same steps as T1a, T1c, T2a, T2b and T4 of the course lab, on the mini data. From Q4 on, the earlier pieces are loaded in their reference version.

General requirements

  • Exact object names (stock_check, product_stock_log, cart_lines, place_order, payment_amount_guard) — the checks call them.
  • A failure must leave nothing behind: the checks catch your error and count orders, lines and stock again.

2. Submission files

RollNo_Name_PG_Lab6/
├── Q1.sql    -- T1a · the stock_check view (2 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- T1c · the ledger trigger (2 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- T2a · cart_lines(jsonb) (2 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- T2b · place_order(customer, items) (2 marks)
├── Q5.sql    -- T4 · a payment must match the order total (2 marks)

3. Data model

product / stock_movement

FieldTypeNotes
product.stockint≥ 0
stock_movement.changeint≠ 0
stock_movement.reasontextimport|sale|return|adjust
stock_movement.order_idbigintoptional

orders / order_item / payment

FieldTypeNotes
orders.customer_idbigint
order_item (order_id, product_id)PKunit_price = price at purchase
payment.order_idbigintUNIQUE
payment.amountnumeric(12,2)must equal the order total

4. Functional requirements

1. T1a · the stock_check view 2 marks

Create stock_check (product_id, sku, stock, ledger, gap): ledger = Σ stock_movement.change of the product (0 if none), gap = stock − ledger.

Requirements:

  • Every product appears (LEFT JOIN a pre-aggregated ledger).

2. T1c · the ledger trigger 2 marks

Trigger product_stock_log: AFTER UPDATE OF stock, one stock_movement row (change = new − old) per product whose stock really changed. The reason comes from current_setting('ctshop.reason', true), default adjust; order_id from ctshop.order_id.

Requirements:

  • WHEN (OLD.stock IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.stock) — an UPDATE that rewrites stock = stock must not log (change = 0 breaks the CHECK).

3. T2a · cart_lines(jsonb) 2 marks

Create cart_lines(p_items jsonb) RETURNS TABLE (product_id bigint, qty int): one row per product, quantities of repeated products added up. Input: [{"product_id": 30, "qty": 1}, {"product_id": 4, "qty": 2}, {"product_id": 4, "qty": 1}].

Requirements:

  • jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) AS x(product_id bigint, qty int) + GROUP BY; IMMUTABLE.

4. T2b · place_order(customer, items) 2 marks

Create place_order(p_customer bigint, p_items jsonb) RETURNS bigint (cart_lines is loaded): validate the cart, lock the products in id order, refuse unknown / inactive / out-of-stock products with RAISE EXCEPTION, then insert the order, its lines at the current price, decrease stock, and return the new order id. Any failure leaves nothing behind.

Requirements:

  • Checks before writes; SELECT … ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE before checking stock.

5. T4 · a payment must match the order total 2 marks

With order_total(order_id) loaded, create the BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger payment_amount_guard on payment that raises an exception when NEW.amount differs from the order total.

Requirements:

  • Function returns NEW when the amount is right (a BEFORE trigger returning NULL would silently drop the payment).

5. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1T1a · the stock_check view2
2T1c · the ledger trigger2
3T2a · cart_lines(jsonb)2
4T2b · place_order(customer, items)2
5T4 · a payment must match the order total2
Total10

Common deductions

  • Checking stock in the application or in a SELECT without FOR UPDATE (two checkouts both see "1 left").
  • Catching and swallowing errors inside place_order — a half order survives.

6. Submission

Tabs Q1.sql … Q5.sql (T1a, T1c, T2a, T2b, T4). Run = sample checks; Submit = every check and the 10-mark table.

Lab 6 — CT Shop: một lượt thanh toán không bao giờ nửa vời

Khoá PostgreSQL · sau Chương 12 · Thời gian gợi ý: 100 phút · 10 điểm (5 × 2)

1. Tổng quan

CT Shop chuyển việc thanh toán vào CSDL: một view kiểm sổ kho, một trigger ghi sổ kho mỗi khi tồn kho đổi, một hàm biến giỏ hàng JSON thành các dòng, chính hàm thanh toán, và một chốt chặn cho thanh toán. Cùng các bước T1a, T1c, T2a, T2b, T4 của lab trong khoá, trên dữ liệu mini. Từ Q4, các phần trước được nạp sẵn bản chuẩn.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Đúng tên đối tượng (stock_check, product_stock_log, cart_lines, place_order, payment_amount_guard) — các kiểm gọi chúng.
  • Hỏng thì không để lại gì: các kiểm bắt lỗi của bạn rồi đếm lại đơn, dòng và tồn kho.

2. Tệp nộp bài

RollNo_Name_PG_Lab6/
├── Q1.sql    -- T1a · the stock_check view (2 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- T1c · the ledger trigger (2 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- T2a · cart_lines(jsonb) (2 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- T2b · place_order(customer, items) (2 marks)
├── Q5.sql    -- T4 · a payment must match the order total (2 marks)

3. Mô hình dữ liệu

product / stock_movement

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
product.stockint≥ 0
stock_movement.changeint≠ 0
stock_movement.reasontextimport|sale|return|adjust
stock_movement.order_idbigintoptional

orders / order_item / payment

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
orders.customer_idbigint
order_item (order_id, product_id)PKunit_price = price at purchase
payment.order_idbigintUNIQUE
payment.amountnumeric(12,2)must equal the order total

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. T1a · view stock_check 2 điểm

Tạo stock_check (product_id, sku, stock, ledger, gap): ledger = Σ stock_movement.change của sản phẩm (0 nếu không có), gap = stock − ledger.

Yêu cầu:

  • Mọi sản phẩm đều xuất hiện (LEFT JOIN sổ kho đã tổng hợp trước).

2. T1c · trigger sổ kho 2 điểm

Trigger product_stock_log: AFTER UPDATE OF stock, mỗi sản phẩm có tồn kho thật sự đổi thì một dòng stock_movement (change = mới − cũ). Lý do lấy từ current_setting('ctshop.reason', true), mặc định adjust; order_id lấy từ ctshop.order_id.

Yêu cầu:

  • WHEN (OLD.stock IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.stock) — UPDATE ghi lại stock = stock không được ghi sổ (change = 0 phạm CHECK).

3. T2a · cart_lines(jsonb) 2 điểm

Tạo cart_lines(p_items jsonb) RETURNS TABLE (product_id bigint, qty int): mỗi sản phẩm một dòng, cộng dồn số lượng của sản phẩm lặp lại. Đầu vào: [{"product_id": 30, "qty": 1}, {"product_id": 4, "qty": 2}, {"product_id": 4, "qty": 1}].

Yêu cầu:

  • jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) AS x(product_id bigint, qty int) + GROUP BY; IMMUTABLE.

4. T2b · place_order(customer, items) 2 điểm

Tạo place_order(p_customer bigint, p_items jsonb) RETURNS bigint (cart_lines đã nạp): kiểm giỏ, khoá sản phẩm theo thứ tự id, từ chối sản phẩm không tồn tại / ngừng bán / hết hàng bằng RAISE EXCEPTION, rồi chèn đơn, các dòng với giá hiện tại, giảm tồn kho, và trả id đơn mới. Hỏng ở đâu cũng không để lại gì.

Yêu cầu:

  • Kiểm trước khi ghi; SELECT … ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE trước khi kiểm tồn kho.

5. T4 · thanh toán phải khớp tổng đơn 2 điểm

Với order_total(order_id) đã nạp, tạo trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE payment_amount_guard trên payment báo lỗi khi NEW.amount khác tổng đơn.

Yêu cầu:

  • Hàm trả NEW khi số tiền đúng (trigger BEFORE trả NULL sẽ lặng lẽ vứt thanh toán).

5. Thang điểm

#Chức năngĐiểm
1T1a · view stock_check2
2T1c · trigger sổ kho2
3T2a · cart_lines(jsonb)2
4T2b · place_order(customer, items)2
5T4 · thanh toán phải khớp tổng đơn2
Tổng10

Lỗi hay bị trừ điểm

  • Kiểm tồn kho ở ứng dụng hoặc bằng SELECT không FOR UPDATE (hai lượt thanh toán đều thấy "còn 1").
  • Bắt rồi nuốt lỗi bên trong place_order — một đơn nửa vời sống sót.

6. Nộp bài

Các tab Q1.sql … Q5.sql (T1a, T1c, T2a, T2b, T4). Chạy thử = kiểm mẫu; Nộp = mọi kiểm và bảng điểm thang 10.

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE VIEW stock_check AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.sku, p.stock,
       coalesce(l.balance, 0) AS ledger,
       p.stock - coalesce(l.balance, 0) AS gap
FROM product p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, sum(change) AS balance FROM stock_movement GROUP BY product_id) l
       ON l.product_id = p.id;

CREATE FUNCTION log_stock_change() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO stock_movement (product_id, change, reason, order_id)
  VALUES (NEW.id,
          NEW.stock - OLD.stock,
          coalesce(nullif(current_setting('ctshop.reason', true), ''), 'adjust'),
          nullif(current_setting('ctshop.order_id', true), '')::bigint);
  RETURN NULL;   -- AFTER trigger: the return value is ignored
END $$;

CREATE TRIGGER product_stock_log
  AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON product
  FOR EACH ROW
  WHEN (OLD.stock IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.stock)   -- an ORM that rewrites stock = stock must not log a 0 change
  EXECUTE FUNCTION log_stock_change();

RETURNS TABLE (product_id bigint, qty int)
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE FUNCTION cart_lines(p_items jsonb)
RETURNS TABLE (product_id bigint, qty int)
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE
AS $$
  SELECT x.product_id, sum(x.qty)::int
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) AS x(product_id bigint, qty int)
  GROUP BY x.product_id
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION order_total(p_order bigint) RETURNS numeric
LANGUAGE sql STABLE
AS $$ SELECT coalesce(sum(qty * unit_price), 0) FROM order_item WHERE order_id = p_order $$;
